<!--
Note on Issue Lifecycle:
New implementation issues normally begin in the `context:needed` state.
Before implementation begins, context is prepared against a known main commit SHA and the label transitions to `context:ready`.
If main changes invalidate prepared context, the issue transitions to `context:stale` until refreshed.
-->
